findings.current: He ordered everyone between him and me to assemble, and…
findings.defect: The Korean specifies the rank range as “above you, below me” (니 위, 내 아래). “Between him and me” changes the reference points and may imply a different group of disciples.
findings.rationale: The speaker contrasts the listener’s rank with his own; the furious Senior Martial Uncle gives the order but is not one of the rank endpoints named in the Korean.
findings.replacement: He ordered everyone ranked above you and below me to assemble, and…

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, with one dialogue line that changes the ranks defining an assembly order.
